# Library "greeter".
# To add a feature: create the .h in include/greeter/, the .cpp here,
# and add the .cpp to the list below.
add_library(greeter STATIC
    message.cpp
    build_info.cpp
)

target_include_directories(greeter
    PUBLIC
        # Headers of the library, for the targets that use it
        $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>  # when building
        $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>                      # once installed
    PRIVATE
        # greeter_config.h, generated by CMake in the build folder,
        # is only used inside the library
        ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}
)

# Install the library and its headers
install(TARGETS greeter
    EXPORT GreeterTargets
    DESTINATION lib
)
install(DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/
    DESTINATION include
)
